items.evidence: Dovepass answers one question for drone operators: given two points, can a drone legally fly between the two points? I build route planning for delivery drivers and wanted to check what it would look like if the vehicle flies. Drone navigation is different from land-based vehicle navigation. In addition to road and traffic data, it requires data on buildings, building height, wind speed and direction, and total load, including the payload a drone might carry. It is also governed by a set of rules; depending on the area, federal, state, or count

items.title: Include bounty_id in gate.verdict and reversal receipt claims
items.evidence: From the Codex review on #2116 (thread 4344749971). For a bounty-only scope, `resolveGateVerdictScope` loads `bountyId`, but the immutable receipt drops it, so a receipt-chain consumer has to read `bounty_task_bindings` to find out which bounty was approved. Fix: add `scope.bountyId` to the claims of both the verdict and reversal receipts. done_when: receipt claims carry `bounty_id`, with a test.

items.evidence: Hi - I run Dominion Observatory (https://dominionobservatory.com), which checks MCP tool manifests for changes. items.title: [Bug] stream:false — proxy-owned tool calls (acp_status / search_context / decompress) are passed through to the client unexecuted; the turn's answer is lost
items.evidence: ## Summary / 现象 With `stream: false`, when the model calls one of the proxy's own tools (`acp_status`, `search_context`, `decompress`), the proxy does **not** execute it. It returns the raw `tool_calls` (`finish_reason: "tool_calls"`) to the client, even though the client never declared these tools. The model's follow-up answer for that turn is lost. items.evidence: **三行结论**：插件默认在 0.0.0.0 监听，且 injectToken 默认开启；README 自己写「任何能网络到达本端口的客户端都免 token 获得完整 dsh 控制权（bash 直通宿主机）」。也就是局域网内任意设备（含被入侵的 IoT/访客设备）不需要 token 就能获得宿主 RCE；「信任整个局域网」被当作默认。 同一份 README 声明自签/CA 私钥与 certs/ 目录为 0600/0700，但 Windows 上 fs.chmod 不生效：自带测试 4 条模式断言全部失败（期望 384/448，实际 438/0644 级），实测私钥/CA 材料是 0666 级可读。 另有 1 条 resolvePluginDir 迁移路径失败（期望 lan-proxy，实际 @wingsky-1/dsh-lan-proxy），记 P2。按 A3 档「局域网/公网暴露面的登录闸」记 P0＋P1。 ## 性质声明 本件是 intake 输入（外部贡献申报），不是悬赏：不 /claim、不自加 bounty 标签。全部读数只覆盖锚定提交；未对目标仓写操作；测试在隔离 clone 内运行，未连真实局域网或公网。 ## 锚定提交 - 仓库：wingsky-1/dsh-plugi

items.title: Security report: tari-ootle ootle-wasm / ootle.ts: stealth amounts outside u64 are reduced modulo 2^64 at the WASM boundary, so 2^64 + 5 is built, proven and validated as 5 (ISSUE-2982)
items.evidence: Retro bounty for @okansaglam016161-pixel for reporting a security vulnerability in `tari-ootle` in a GitHub issue: https://github.com/tari-project/tari-ootle/issues/2982. The report showed that ootle-wasm / ootle.ts: stealth amounts outside u64 are reduced modulo 2^64 at the WASM boundary, so 2^64 + 5 is built, proven and validated as 5. The reporter did not touch any shared network. The fix was implemented separately by @sdbondi in tari-project/tari-ootle#2983. **No code work is required here.** Details stay in the advisory until it is publish
